description: This file contains testing utilities for React components, including render wrappers with context providers and routers, deep equality checks, and mock fetch setup for testing API calls.

methods.name: renderWithAppProvider
methods.description: Renders a React component wrapped solely with AppProvider, without any Router.

methods.name: renderWithRouterOnly
methods.description: Renders a React component wrapped exclusively with a Router (BrowserRouter or MemoryRouter), useful for testing components that require routing.

methods.name: renderWithAppProviderAndRouter
methods.description: Renders a React component wrapped with both AppProvider and Router, used for tests needing both contexts.

methods.name: deepEqual
methods.description: Performs a deep comparison between two values, supporting primitives and plain objects.

methods.name: mockFetchOnce
methods.description: Mocks a single fetch response with provided data, a legacy helper for tests.

methods.name: mockFetchOnceError
methods.description: Mocks a fetch response representing an error condition, for testing error handling.

methods.name: mockFetchQueue
methods.description: Enqueues a sequence of fetch mock responses matching specified request patterns.

methods.name: resetMockFetchQueue
methods.description: Clears fetch expectations and resets the mock fetch implementation; intended for use in test cleanup.

methods.name: getMockFetchQueueSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of remaining fetch expectations in the queue for debugging.

methods.name: assertNoPendingFetchMocks
methods.description: Throws an error if there are any unconsumed fetch mock expectations, indicating incomplete tests.
